goal: Prevent loss of pending private broadcast transactions when a node shuts down or restarts
Ensure transactions submitted for private broadcast over Tor or I2P are relayed after reboot
agreement: Concept support for avoiding transaction loss across restarts (vasild, craigraw)
Unaddressed objection: unrestricted file permissions could leak private broadcast data (vasild)
Privacy concern that storing broadcast data on disk expands the attack surface (tankyleo)
Suggested a full broadcast pool would better handle crashes and mempool eviction (craigraw)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it prevents silent transaction loss across restarts for nodes using private broadcast
Protects relay reliability and liveness for transactions waiting for Tor or I2P broadcast
